purpose: Define explicit remote semantic dereference through declared peer/external identities and DWH-style remote addressing, preventing direct transport endpoints or raw external handles from bypassing canonical authorization boundaries.

topics.name: Remote Dereference
topics.purpose: Define explicit remote semantic dereference through declared peer/external identities and DWH-style remote addressing, preventing direct transport endpoints or raw external handles from bypassing canonical authorization boundaries.

semantics.identity_rule: Remote peer identity is declared semantic identity; IP/port/session id is transport binding only.
semantics.address_rule: Remote marker/address resolves through an owning remote/DWH contract, not direct filesystem/network dereference.
semantics.authorization_rule: Remote rights are evaluated at the remote semantic authority boundary.
semantics.ac_rule: When AccessCore is active, direct raw $EXT dereference is not an alternate bypass path; governed remote access uses the declared DWH/remote route.
semantics.read_only_default: External/remote surfaces default read-only unless explicit write authority exists.
semantics.payload_rule: Remote payload cannot dynamically select a broader root/authority scope.

invariants.rule: Network identity, transport, remote authority and payload semantics remain explicit and separate.
